conclusions.title: Mission conclusion engine
conclusions.conclusion: The site should treat every page as part of one intelligence loop: collect source, classify it, grade evidence, connect it to the map, publish a bounded conclusion, then review it when new records arrive.
conclusions.why: This turns the site from an archive into a living research machine.
conclusions.boundary: This is an editorial workflow, not proof that any mapped actor has secret intent or wrongdoing.
conclusions.next: Use information-gathering-system.html as the operating manual and conclusion-engine.html as the reader-facing output route.

conclusions.boundary: Card inclusion is research relevance, not accusation.

conclusions.why: This prevents the forum/intake areas from becoming rumour dumps and makes them useful for research.

conclusions.next: Push all intake areas toward the same evidence-slot standard.

topDrops.evidenceBoundary: Implementation dates and obligations are not proof of censorship or abuse. Track the legal text, guidance, enforcement actions, standards, national authorities, and actual platform behaviour separately.

topDrops.title: WHO Pandemic Agreement remains adopted but not fully open for ratification until PABS annex is negotiated
topDrops.summary: WHO states the Pandemic Agreement was adopted on 20 May 2025, but the next step is negotiation of the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing system as an annex. WHO lists the seventh IGWG meeting on the Agreement for 6–17 July 2026.
topDrops.evidenceBoundary: Treaty adoption is not the same as force, ratification, domestic implementation, or WHO control over national measures. WHO states the agreement does not authorize it to impose lockdowns or vaccine mandates.

topDrops.summary: A June 2026 study on EUDI Wallet-style credential disclosure warns that users may overshare sensitive credentials, including official ID attributes, and that assistant-style mitigations reduce but do not eliminate disclosure mistakes.

topDrops.title: ECB says digital euro aims for potential first issuance during 2029 if EU legislation is adopted in 2026
topDrops.summary: The ECB states the Eurosystem moved to the next phase of the digital euro project in October 2025 and aims to be ready for potential first issuance during 2029, assuming EU legislation is adopted during 2026. The ECB frames the digital euro as a central-bank digital form of cash complementing banknotes and coins.
topDrops.evidenceLevel: Official ECB CBDC project timeline / legislation and technical-readiness lane
topDrops.evidenceBoundary: A readiness target is not a final launch. Track legislation, pilots, wallet design, holding limits, privacy design, bank costs, merchant rules, and adoption requirements separately.
topDrops.whyItMatters: The money-rails clock is now tied to legislative timing, technical readiness, euro-area payment sovereignty, online/offline design, and the relationship between digital public money and existing private payment systems.
topDrops.nextAction: Update CBDC Rollout and Financial Reset clocks; watch 2026 legislative adoption, 2027 testing, wallet provider rules, privacy architecture, and 2029 issuance decision.
